snippet.title: Demon Hunters on Steam - Pre-Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Add to wishlist - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183640?utm_source=yt

Demon Hunters is a 2D RPG with roguelike elements where you explore dungeons, fight hordes of enemies and epic bosses. Upgrade weapons, collect artifacts and close the demonic portal!

Мы в Discord - https://discord.gg/dHnaAQNevd

Небольшие видеоуроки по моделированию в программе Blender 3D. Подойдет для новичков начинающих свой путь в интересный мир 3D графики.
Small video tutorials about modeling in Blender 3D. Suitable for beginners starting their way into the interesting world of 3D graphics.
